==Trivia==
* Unique Trait in '''{{PAGENAME}}''' makes the enemy affected by '''Pact Of Frailty''' take '''150% increased''' {{Damage Type|Magic}} '''damage''' instead of the 50% they would normally take with just 1 placement of '''{{PAGENAME}}'''.
* Pact Of Frailty can only stack up to '''300% increased''' {{Damage Type|Magic}} '''damage'''
* Pact Of Frailty depends on '''{{PAGENAME}}''' target system, so if she was set ''strongest'' while reached to full AOE upgrade, her passive only target highest HP enemy within her range.
